verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל׀ לְֽמִסְפָּרָ֡ם רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֣וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֣י הָֽאֲלָפִ֣ים׀ וְהַמֵּא֡וֹת וְשֹׁטְרֵיהֶם֩ הַמְשָׁרְתִ֨ים אֶת־ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לְכֹ֣ל׀ דְּבַ֣ר הַֽמַּחְלְק֗וֹת הַבָּאָ֤ה וְהַיֹּצֵאת֙ חֹ֣דֶשׁ בְּחֹ֔דֶשׁ לְכֹ֖ל חָדְשֵׁ֣י הַשָּׁנָ֑ה הַֽמַּחֲלֹ֙קֶת֙ הָֽאַחַ֔ת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lə·mis·pā·rām rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ wə·śā·rê hā·’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·ham·mê·’ō·wṯ wə·šō·ṭə·rê·hem ham·šā·rə·ṯîm ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ lə·ḵōl də·ḇar ham·maḥ·lə·qō·wṯ hab·bā·’āh wə·hay·yō·ṣêṯ ḥō·ḏeš bə·ḥō·ḏeš lə·ḵōl ḥā·ḏə·šê haš·šā·nāh ham·ma·ḥă·lō·qeṯ hā·’a·ḥaṯ ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: This is the list of the Israelites the heads of families the commanders of thousands and of hundreds and their officers who served the king in every matter concerning the divisions on rotating military duty . . . each month . . . throughout . . . the year There were 24,000 men . . . . . . in each division
verses.literalPt: Ora, os filhos de Israel, segundo o seu número, a saber, os cabeças das famílias, e os capitães de mil e de cem, e seus oficiais que serviram ao rei em qualquer negócio das turmas que entravam e saíam cada mês durante todos os meses do ano, eram, em cada turma, vinte e quatro mil.

verses.original: עַ֞ל הַמַּחֲלֹ֤קֶת הָרִֽאשׁוֹנָה֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן יָֽשָׁבְעָ֖ם בֶּן־ זַבְדִּיאֵ֑ל וְעַל֙ מַֽחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al ham·ma·ḥă·lō·qeṯ hā·ri·šō·w·nāh la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn yā·šā·ḇə·‘ām ben- zaḇ·dî·’êl wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: Jashobeam son of Zabdiel was in charge of the first division which was assigned the first month There were 24,000 . . . . . . men in his division
verses.literalPt: Sobre a primeira turma, no primeiro mês, estava Jasobeão, filho de Zabdiel; e, na sua turma, havia vinte e quatro mil.

verses.original: מִן־ בְּנֵי־ פֶ֗רֶץ הָרֹ֛אשׁ לְכָל־ שָׂרֵ֥י הַצְּבָא֖וֹת לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: min- bə·nê- p̄e·reṣ hā·rōš lə·ḵāl śā·rê haṣ·ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn
verses.literal: He was a descendant of Perez and chief of all the army commanders for the first month
verses.literalPt: Era ele dos filhos de Perez e chefe de todos os capitães do exército no primeiro mês.

verses.original: וְעַ֞ל מַחֲלֹ֣קֶת׀ הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֗י דּוֹדַ֤י הָאֲחוֹחִי֙ וּמַ֣חֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ וּמִקְל֖וֹת הַנָּגִ֑יד וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al ma·ḥă·lō·qeṯ ha·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šê·nî dō·w·ḏay hā·’ă·ḥō·w·ḥî ū·ma·ḥă·luq·tōw ū·miq·lō·wṯ han·nā·ḡîḏ wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: Dodai the Ahohite was in charge of the division for the second month and Mikloth was the leader There were 24,000 . . . . . . men in . . . his division
verses.literalPt: Sobre a turma do segundo mês estava Dodai, aoíta… e sua turma, Miclote comandava, e, na sua turma, havia vinte e quatro mil.

verses.original: שַׂ֣ר הַצָּבָ֤א הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בְּנָיָ֧הוּ בֶן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֛ע הַכֹּהֵ֖ן רֹ֑אשׁ וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: śar haṣ·ṣā·ḇā haš·šə·lî·šî la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·lî·šî bə·nā·yā·hū ḇen- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ hak·kō·hên rōš wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: The third army commander as chief for the third month was Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest There were 24,000 . . . . . . men in his division
verses.literalPt: O terceiro capitão do exército, no terceiro mês, era Benaia, filho do sacerdote Joiada, chefe, e, na sua turma, havia vinte e quatro mil.

verses.original: ה֧וּא בְנָיָ֛הוּ גִּבּ֥וֹר הַשְּׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־ הַשְּׁלֹשִׁ֑ים וּמַ֣חֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עַמִּיזָבָ֖ד בְּנֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hū ḇə·nā·yā·hū gib·bō·wr haš·šə·lō·šîm wə·‘al- haš·šə·lō·šîm ū·ma·ḥă·luq·tōw ‘am·mî·zā·ḇāḏ bə·nōw
verses.literal: This Benaiah was mighty among the Thirty and was over the Thirty and his son Ammizabad was in charge of his division
verses.literalPt: Este é aquele Benaia, que era o homem poderoso entre os trinta e comandante dos trinta; e da sua turma era seu filho Amizabade.

verses.original: הָֽרְבִיעִ֞י לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרְבִיעִ֗י עֲשָׂה־ אֵל֙ אֲחִ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב וּזְבַדְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ אַחֲרָ֑יו וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·rə·ḇî·‘î la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·rə·ḇî·‘î ‘ă·śāh- ’êl ’ă·ḥî yō·w·’āḇ ū·zə·ḇaḏ·yāh ḇə·nōw ’a·ḥă·rāw wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: The fourth for the fourth month was Joab’s brother Asahel and his son Zebadiah was commander after him There were 24,000 . . . . . . men in his division
verses.literalPt: O quarto capitão, no quarto mês, era Asael, irmão de Joabe, e, depois dele, Zebadias, seu filho; e, na sua turma, havia vinte e quatro mil.

verses.original: הַחַמִישִׁי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁ֔י הַשַּׂ֖ר שַׁמְה֣וּת הַיִּזְרָ֑ח וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥa·mî·šî la·ḥō·ḏeš ha·ḥă·mî·šî haś·śar šam·hūṯ hay·yiz·rāḥ wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: The fifth for the fifth month was the commander Shamhuth the Izrahite There were 24,000 . . . . . . men in his division
verses.literalPt: O quinto capitão, no quinto mês, era Samute, izraíta; e, na sua turma, havia vinte e quatro mil.

verses.original: הַשִּׁשִּׁי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י עִירָ֥א בֶן־ עִקֵּ֖שׁ הַתְּקוֹעִ֑י וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: haš·šiš·šî la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šiš·šî ‘î·rā ḇen- ‘iq·qêš hat·tə·qō·w·‘î wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: The sixth for the sixth month was Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite There were 24,000 . . . . . . men in his division
verses.literalPt: O sexto capitão, no sexto mês, era Ira, filho de Iques, tecoíta; e, na sua turma, havia vinte e quatro mil.

verses.original: הַשְּׁבִיעִי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י חֶ֥לֶץ הַפְּלוֹנִ֖י מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·ḇî·‘î la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇî·‘î ḥe·leṣ hap·pə·lō·w·nî min- bə·nê ’ep̄·rā·yim wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: The seventh for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite an Ephraimite There were 24,000 . . . . . . men in his division
verses.literalPt: O sétimo capitão, no sétimo mês, era Helez, pelonita, dos filhos de Efraim; e, na sua turma, havia vinte e quatro mil.

verses.original: הַשְּׁמִינִי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י סִבְּכַ֥י הַחֻשָׁתִ֖י לַזַּרְחִ֑י וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·mî·nî la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·mî·nî sib·bə·ḵay ha·ḥu·šā·ṯî laz·zar·ḥî wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: The eighth for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite a Zerahite There were 24,000 . . . . . . men in his division
verses.literalPt: O oitavo capitão, no oitavo mês, era Sibecai, husatita, dos zeraítas; e, na sua turma, havia vinte e quatro mil.

verses.original: הַתְּשִׁיעִי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִ֔י אֲבִיעֶ֥זֶר הָעַנְּתֹתִ֖י לַבֶּנְיְמִינִי וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: hat·tə·šî·‘î la·ḥō·ḏeš hat·tə·šî·‘î ’ă·ḇî·‘e·zer hā·‘an·nə·ṯō·ṯî lab·bɛn·yə·mī·nī wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: The ninth for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite a Benjamite There were 24,000 . . . . . . men in his division
verses.literalPt: O nono capitão, no nono mês, era Abiezer, anatotita, dos benjamitas; e, na sua turma, havia vinte e quatro mil.

verses.original: הָעֲשִׂירִי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִ֔י מַהְרַ֥י הַנְּטֽוֹפָתִ֖י לַזַּרְחִ֑י וְעַל֙ מַֽחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ă·śî·rî la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·‘ă·śî·rî mah·ray han·nə·ṭō·w·p̄ā·ṯî laz·zar·ḥî wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: The tenth for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite a Zerahite There were 24,000 . . . . . . men in his division
verses.literalPt: O décimo capitão, no décimo mês, era Maarai, netofatita, dos zeraítas; e, na sua turma, havia vinte e quatro mil.

verses.original: עַשְׁתֵּֽי־ עָשָׂר֙ לְעַשְׁתֵּ֣י־ עָשָׂ֣ר הַחֹ֔דֶשׁ בְּנָיָ֥ה הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִ֖י מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘aš·tê- ‘ā·śār lə·‘aš·tê- ‘ā·śār ha·ḥō·ḏeš bə·nā·yāh hap·pir·‘ā·ṯō·w·nî min- bə·nê ’ep̄·rā·yim wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: The eleventh . . . for the eleventh . . . month was Benaiah the Pirathonite an Ephraimite There were 24,000 . . . . . . men in his division
verses.literalPt: O undécimo capitão, no undécimo mês, era Benaia, piratonita, dos filhos de Efraim; e, na sua turma, havia vinte e quatro mil.

verses.original: הַשְּׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ לִשְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֣ר הַחֹ֔דֶשׁ חֶלְדַּ֥י הַנְּטוֹפָתִ֖י לְעָתְנִיאֵ֑ל וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃פ
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·nêm ‘ā·śār liš·nêm ‘ā·śār ha·ḥō·ḏeš ḥel·day han·nə·ṭō·w·p̄ā·ṯî lə·‘ā·ṯə·nî·’êl wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: The twelfth . . . for the twelfth . . . month was Heldai the Netophathite from the family of Othniel There were 24,000 . . . . . . men in his division
verses.literalPt: O duodécimo capitão, no duodécimo mês, era Heldai, netofatita, de Otniel; e, na sua turma, havia vinte e quatro mil.

verses.original: וְעַל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָרֽאוּבֵנִ֣י נָגִ֔יד אֱלִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־ זִכְרִ֑יס לַשִּׁ֨מְעוֹנִ֔י שְׁפַטְיָ֖הוּ בֶּֽן־ מַעֲכָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl lā·r·’ū·ḇê·nî nā·ḡîḏ ’ĕ·lî·‘e·zer ben- ziḵ·rīs laš·šim·‘ō·w·nî šə·p̄aṭ·yā·hū ben- ma·‘ă·ḵāh
verses.literal: These officers were in charge of . . . the tribes of Israel Over the Reubenites was Eliezer son of Zichri over the Simeonites was Shephatiah son of Maacah
verses.literalPt: Além disso, sobre as tribos de Israel: sobre os rubenitas era chefe Eliézer, filho de Zicri; sobre os simeonitas, Sefatias, filho de Maaca;

verses.original: לְלֵוִ֛י חֲשַׁבְיָ֥ה בֶן־ קְמוּאֵ֖ל לְאַהֲרֹ֥ן צָדֽוֹק׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·lê·wî ḥă·šaḇ·yāh ḇen- qə·mū·’êl lə·’a·hă·rōn ṣā·ḏō·wq
verses.literal: over Levi was Hashabiah son of Kemuel over Aaron was Zadok
verses.literalPt: sobre Levi, Hasabias, filho de Quemuel; sobre Arão, Zadoque;

verses.original: לִֽיהוּדָ֕ה אֱלִיה֖וּ מֵאֲחֵ֣י דָוִ֑יד לְיִ֨שָׂשכָ֔ר עָמְרִ֖י בֶּן־ מִיכָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: lî·hū·ḏāh ’ĕ·lî·hū mê·’ă·ḥê ḏā·wîḏ lə·yi·śā·š·ḵār ‘ā·mə·rî ben- mî·ḵā·’êl
verses.literal: over Judah was Elihu one of David’s brothers over Issachar was Omri son of Michael
verses.literalPt: sobre Judá, Eliú, um dos irmãos de Davi; sobre Issacar, Onri, filho de Micael;

verses.original: לִזְבוּלֻ֕ן יִֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ עֹבַדְיָ֑הוּ לְנַ֨פְתָּלִ֔י יְרִימ֖וֹת בֶּן־ עַזְרִיאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: liz·ḇū·lun yiš·ma‘·yā·hū ben- ‘ō·ḇaḏ·yā·hū lə·nap̄·tā·lî yə·rî·mō·wṯ ben- ‘az·rî·’êl
verses.literal: over Zebulun was Ishmaiah son of Obadiah over Naphtali was Jerimoth son of Azriel
verses.literalPt: sobre Zebulom, Irmaías, filho de Obadias; sobre Naftali, Jeremote, filho de Azriel;

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם הוֹשֵׁ֖עַ בֶּן־ עֲזַזְיָ֑הוּ לַחֲצִי֙ שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה יוֹאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ פְּדָיָֽהוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê ’ep̄·ra·yim hō·wō·šê·a‘ ben- ‘ă·zaz·yā·hū la·ḥă·ṣî šê·ḇeṭ mə·naš·šeh yō·w·’êl ben- pə·ḏā·yā·hū
verses.literal: over the Ephraimites . . . was Hoshea son of Azaziah over one of the half-tribes . . . of Manasseh was Joel son of Pedaiah
verses.literalPt: sobre os filhos de Efraim, Oseias, filho de Azazias; sobre a meia tribo de Manassés, Joel, filho de Pedaías;

verses.original: לַחֲצִ֤י הַֽמְנַשֶּׁה֙ גִּלְעָ֔דָה יִדּ֖וֹ בֶּן־ זְכַרְיָ֑הוּס לְבִנְיָמִ֔ן יַעֲשִׂיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ אַבְנֵֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: la·ḥă·ṣî ham·naš·šeh gil·‘ā·ḏāh yid·dōw ben- zə·ḵar·yå̄·hūs lə·ḇin·yā·min ya·‘ă·śî·’êl ben- ’aḇ·nêr
verses.literal: over the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead was Iddo son of Zechariah over Benjamin was Jaasiel son of Abner
verses.literalPt: sobre a meia tribo de Manassés, em Gileade, Ido, filho de Zacarias; sobre Benjamim, Jaasiel, filho de Abner;

verses.original: לְדָ֕ן עֲזַרְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ יְרֹחָ֑ם אֵ֕לֶּה שָׂרֵ֖י שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏān ‘ă·zar·’êl ben- yə·rō·ḥām ’êl·leh śā·rê šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: and over Dan was Azarel son of Jeroham These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel
verses.literalPt: e sobre Dã, Azarel, filho de Jeroão. Estes eram capitães das tribos de Israel.

verses.original: וְלֹא־ נָשָׂ֤א דָוִיד֙ מִסְפָּרָ֔ם לְמִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּלְמָ֑טָּה כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לְהַרְבּ֥וֹת אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- nā·śā ḏā·wîḏ mis·pā·rām lə·mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh ū·lə·māṭ·ṭāh kî ’ā·mar Yah·weh lə·har·bō·wṯ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl kə·ḵō·wḵ·ḇê haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: David did not count . . . the men aged twenty or under because the LORD had said that He would make Israel as numerous as the stars of the sky
verses.literalPt: Mas Davi não contou os que eram de vinte anos e daí para baixo, porque Jeová tinha dito que multiplicaria a Israel como as estrelas do céu.

verses.original: יוֹאָ֨ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֜ה הֵחֵ֤ל לִמְנוֹת֙ וְלֹ֣א כִלָּ֔ה וַיְהִ֥י בָזֹ֛את קֶ֖צֶף עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֤א עָלָה֙ הַמִּסְפָּ֔ר בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר דִּבְרֵֽי־ הַיָּמִ֖ים לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽיד׃ס
verses.transliteration: yō·w·’āḇ ben- ṣə·rū·yāh hê·ḥêl lim·nō·wṯ wə·lō ḵil·lāh way·hî ḇā·zōṯ qe·ṣep̄ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō ‘ā·lāh ham·mis·pār bə·mis·par diḇ·rê- hay·yā·mîm lam·me·leḵ dā·wîḏ
verses.literal: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count the men but did not finish For because of this census wrath came upon Israel and the number was not entered . . . in the Book of the Chronicles of King David
verses.literalPt: Joabe, filho de Zeruia, tinha começado a fazer a resenha, porém não acabou (e, por isso, veio ira sobre Israel), nem foi o número posto no Livro das Crônicas do Rei Davi.

verses.original: וְעַל֙ אֹצְר֣וֹת הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ עַזְמָ֖וֶת בֶּן־ עֲדִיאֵ֑לס וְעַ֣ל הָֽאֹצָר֡וֹת בַּשָּׂדֶ֞ה בֶּעָרִ֤ים וּבַכְּפָרִים֙ וּבַמִּגְדָּל֔וֹת יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן בֶּן־ עֻזִּיָּֽהוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al ’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ ham·me·leḵ ‘az·mā·weṯ ben- ʿă·ḏī·ʾē·ls wə·‘al hā·’ō·ṣā·rō·wṯ baś·śā·ḏeh be·‘ā·rîm ū·ḇak·kə·p̄ā·rîm ū·ḇam·miḡ·dā·lō·wṯ yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān ben- ‘uz·zî·yā·hū
verses.literal: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the royal storehouses Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the storehouses in the country in the cities in the villages and in the fortresses
verses.literalPt: Sobre os tesouros do rei estava Azmavete, filho de Adiel; sobre os tesouros nos campos, nas cidades, nas vilas e nos castelos, Jônatas, filho de Uzias;

verses.original: וְעַ֗ל עֹשֵׂי֙ מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה לַעֲבֹדַ֖ת הָאֲדָמָ֑ה עֶזְרִ֖י בֶּן־ כְּלֽוּב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al ‘ō·śê mə·le·ḵeṯ haś·śā·ḏeh la·‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ‘ez·rî ben- kə·lūḇ
verses.literal: Ezri son of Chelub was in charge of the workers . . . in the fields who tilled the soil
verses.literalPt: sobre os que faziam a obra do campo, na lavoura da terra, estava Ezri, filho de Quelube;

verses.original: וְעַל־ הַ֨כְּרָמִ֔ים שִׁמְעִ֖י הָרָֽמָתִ֑י וְעַ֤ל שֶׁבַּכְּרָמִים֙ לְאֹצְר֣וֹת הַיַּ֔יִן זַבְדִּ֖י הַשִּׁפְמִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- hak·kə·rā·mîm šim·‘î hā·rā·mā·ṯî wə·‘al šeb·bak·kə·rā·mîm lə·’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ hay·ya·yin zaḇ·dî haš·šip̄·mî
verses.literal: Shimei the Ramathite was in charge of the vineyards Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of the produce of the vineyards for the wine vats
verses.literalPt: sobre as vinhas, Simei, ramatita; sobre o que era das vinhas nas adegas, Zabdi, sifmita;

verses.original: וְעַל־ הַזֵּיתִ֤ים וְהַשִּׁקְמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשְּׁפֵלָ֔ה בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן הַגְּדֵרִ֑יס וְעַל־ אֹצְר֥וֹת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן יוֹעָֽשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- haz·zê·ṯîm wə·haš·šiq·mîm ’ă·šer baš·šə·p̄ê·lāh ba·‘al ḥā·nān hag·gə·ḏē·rīs wə·‘al- ’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ haš·še·men yō·w·‘āš
verses.literal: Baal-hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the foothills Joash was in charge of the stores of olive oil
verses.literalPt: sobre os olivais e sicômoros, que havia nas campinas, Baal-Hanã, gederita; sobre os armazéns de azeite, Joás;

verses.original: וְעַל־ הַבָּקָר֙ הָרֹעִ֣ים בַּשָּׁר֔וֹן שִׁטְרַי הַשָּׁרוֹנִ֑י וְעַל־ הַבָּקָר֙ בָּֽעֲמָקִ֔ים שָׁפָ֖ט בֶּן־ עַדְלָֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- hab·bā·qār hā·rō·‘îm baš·šā·rō·wn šiṭ·ray haš·šā·rō·w·nî wə·‘al- hab·bā·qār bā·‘ă·mā·qîm šā·p̄āṭ ben- ‘aḏ·lāy
verses.literal: Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds grazing in Sharon Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the herds in the valleys
verses.literalPt: sobre os gados que pastavam em Sarom, Sitrai, saronita; sobre os gados que estavam nos vales, Safate, filho de Adlai;

verses.original: וְעַל־ הַ֨גְּמַלִּ֔ים אוֹבִ֖יל הַיִּשְׁמְעֵלִ֑י וְעַל־ הָ֣אֲתֹנ֔וֹת יֶחְדְּיָ֖הוּ הַמֵּרֹנֹתִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- hag·gə·mal·lîm ’ō·w·ḇîl hay·yiš·mə·‘ê·lî wə·‘al- hā·’ă·ṯō·nō·wṯ yeḥ·də·yā·hū ham·mê·rō·nō·ṯî
verses.literal: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys
verses.literalPt: sobre os camelos, Obil, ismaelita; sobre os jumentos, Jedias, meronotita;

verses.original: וְעַל־ הַצֹּ֖אן יָזִ֣יז הַֽהַגְרִ֑י כָּל־ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָרְכ֔וּשׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- haṣ·ṣōn yā·zîz ha·haḡ·rî kāl- ’êl·leh śā·rê hā·rə·ḵūš ’ă·šer lam·me·leḵ dā·wîḏ
verses.literal: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the flocks All these officials were in charge of King David’s property
verses.literalPt: e sobre os rebanhos, Jaziz, hagareno. Todos estes eram os intendentes da fazenda do rei Davi.

verses.original: וִֽיהוֹנָתָ֤ן דּוֹד־ דָּוִיד֙ יוֹעֵ֔ץ אִישׁ־ מֵבִ֥ין וְסוֹפֵ֖ר ה֑וּא וִֽיחִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן־ חַכְמוֹנִ֖י עִם־ בְּנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hō·w·nā·ṯān dō·wḏ- dā·wîḏ yō·w·‘êṣ ’îš- mê·ḇîn wə·sō·w·p̄êr hū wî·ḥî·’êl ben- ḥaḵ·mō·w·nî ‘im- bə·nê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: David’s uncle Jonathan was a counselor he was a man of insight and a scribe Jehiel son of Hachmoni attended to the sons of the king
verses.literalPt: Jônatas, tio de Davi, era conselheiro, homem entendido e escriba; Jeiel, filho de Hacmoni, estava com os filhos do rei;

verses.original: וַאֲחִיתֹ֖פֶל יוֹעֵ֣ץ לַמֶּ֑לֶךְס וְחוּשַׁ֥י הָאַרְכִּ֖י רֵ֥עַ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥî·ṯō·p̄el yō·w·‘êṣ lam·mɛ·lɛḵs wə·ḥū·šay hā·’ar·kî rê·a‘ ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend
verses.literalPt: Aitofel era conselheiro do rei; Husai, arquita, era privado do rei;

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵ֣י אֲחִיתֹ֗פֶל יְהוֹיָדָ֤ע בֶּן־ בְּנָיָ֙הוּ֙ וְאֶבְיָתָ֔ר וְשַׂר־ צָבָ֥א לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יוֹאָֽב׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rê ’ă·ḥî·ṯō·p̄el yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ ben- bə·nā·yā·hū wə·’eḇ·yā·ṯār wə·śar- ṣā·ḇā lam·me·leḵ yō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada son of Benaiah then by Abiathar Joab was the commander of the king’s army
verses.literalPt: depois de Aitofel, eram Joiada, filho de Benaia, e Abiatar; e o capitão do exército do rei era Joabe.
